name: Clinical question and timeline
description: Define population, endpoint meaning and event timing.

name: Source qualification and executable analysis
description: Qualify measured inputs and suggest traceable preparation and executable analyses appropriate to their assay and study design.

name: Design and uncertainty review
description: Match analysis and validation to the estimand, experimental unit and data-generating design.

name: Exposure qualification
description: Require actual dose, concentration and sampling timestamps before reconstructing exposure or PK/PD.

name: Mechanistic and BioNeMo prediction qualification
description: Use validated transcript/variant mapping, exact WT/mutant or reference/candidate sequences and provenance.

name: Competing mechanism synthesis
description: Connect the clinical question to mechanisms and discriminating experiments using accepted omics/statistical/functional evidence.

name: Discriminating assay and experimental handoff
description: Check specimen availability, assay fitness, method/version, matched comparisons, controls, endpoints and QC.

name: Evidence integration and bounded investigation
description: Preserve the supplied hypothesis wording and source; distinguish agent alternatives.

name: Independent challenge and analysis cycle
description: Challenge source identities, versions, numeric support, independence, causality and experiment fitness.

name: NVIDIA BioNeMo Boltz2 NIM

description: Actual hosted/local prediction contract, input qualification and output interpretation.

name: Role-owned discovery and tool selection
origin: Team TBD: role-specific scientific planning and registered capability contract
description: Choose question-driven preparation and available analyses without embedding dataset-specific answers or fixed pipelines.

name: Clear findings and working scientific answer
description: Plain-language evidence synthesis, scoped working answers and model-prepared comparison context.

name: Returned molecular artifact interpretation
description: Exact sequence identity, confidence semantics, settings comparability and scoped structural interpretation.

name: Rosalind-informed scientific workflow

description: Question-driven evidence, tool execution, hypothesis testing and scientific follow-up with truthful source and model attribution.
